summary: I developed a web-based interactive story that addresses the challenge by turning NASA data into a simple story, which is a good educational tool for school-age space enthusiasts. It is important because it can inspire the next generation and teach them more about important equipment that helped dreams come true and made enormous discoveries that turned science fiction into reality.
details:
It is an interactive, web-based storytelling and research project that explores abandoned human-made equipment in space, especially the rovers Spirit and Opportunity.

The project works through an interactive website that combines storytelling, research, and information presentation. Rather than presenting information as a conventional research paper, it guides visitors through a structured digital experience, allowing them to explore the subject and understand the stories behind abandoned space equipment.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project aims to:

  • Raise awareness of abandoned space equipment and its place in human space exploration.
  • Make scientific and historical information more enjoyable and easier to understand.
  • Encourage young people, teenagers, and even younger children to read rather than watch, and change their perception that reading is boring.
  • Capture the attention of younger and more casual audiences.

Tools and Technologies

The project is being developed using:

  • HTML: To structure the website and its content.
  • CSS: To design the visual appearance, layout, and overall experience.
  • JavaScript: To implement interactive elements and navigation.
  • A laptop and web browser: For development, testing, and viewing the website.

Creativity

My project is creative because I do not have an external narrator in the story. Instead, Spirit and Opportunity are the narrators themselves. I also give their speech a warm, human tone rather than a harsh tone.

Factors Considered

Several factors were considered:

  • Scientific accuracy: Information should be supported by credible research and reliable sources.
  • Educational value: The content should be understandable and meaningful to visitors.
  • Technical accessibility: The project should be viewable through a web browser without requiring specialized software from visitors.

Additional information: I used AI in coding.
